changelog: The broadcast works. Two things stopped it: the server read the publish secret with parse_str(), and MediaMTX hands the query over with the publish path glued to it, so the secret was never seen and every publish was refused; and the app's notification poll walked the inbox without a cursor, so it fetched the same fifty conversations over and over - about three hundred requests in a burst - which tripped the rate limiter and left the operator with an empty inbox and a "Connection failed" banner. The app also says what is wrong now: a token that cannot broadcast is told so, and granting the camera goes straight on to the broadcast.
